notes.title: English version released on October 24th & 31% OFF sale now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42171696/37811e2fcff48cb55d0b86ee71c540b00db0b674.jpg[/img]

Think you can just fight it off with weapons? Think again. PREDATOR AND WRECK drops you into the stillness of space with nothing more than your senses and wits! Feel the fear and adrenaline as you sneak around defenseless, trying to outmaneuver the unknown creature!


[b]On October 24, English language was added to this title, which took a team of Japanese students three years to develop.
This will be the first time this title will be available in English language!
(Only the Japanese version was released in May.)

We will have a 31% off sale on steam from October 24th to November 6th.[/b]


[h2]■ Story [/h2]
After receiving a distress signal from a space station, you head over to investigate a mysterious explosion and search for survivors. Upon arriving, however, you come into contact with an unknown life form that feeds on humans. Can you unravel the mystery behind the creature and make it out alive?

[h2]■ Stealth Elements [/h2]
・Listen closely to the terrifying life form’s footsteps and groans to avoid coming face-to-face with it.
・Distract it by turning on alarms, or using fire extinguishers to cloud its vision.
・Hide yourself in shelters scattered throughout the space station.

[h2]■ Game Features [/h2]
・Solve intricate puzzles to aid in your escape.
・Face the life form without any weapons, completely defenseless.
・Enjoy a streamlined gaming experience with a single ending.
・Influence the content of the end-game incident report and find out what really happened by checking computers around the space station.
・Resume your game progress with auto-save and manual save options.


Test your mettle with the award-winning stealth horror/sci-fi game PREDATOR AND WRECK.

notes.title: ver1.1.0 is now available.
notes.content:
Ver. 1.1.0, which reflects user feedback on ver. 1.0.0, is now available.

This game is currently only available in Japanese.
Translation work is currently underway.
[b]English version will be released by the end of this year.
Please add this game to your wish list and wait.[/b]

This title can be completed in Normal mode in about 2 hours. Since the game has an auto-save feature that reduces rework and allows for quick play, it is recommended for those who are new to playing horror games. Also, in Easy mode, you can check the map at any time.

Major changes
The difficulty level of Expert Mode has been greatly improved. The difficulty level has been made more tense.

Changed footsteps when enemies are on different floors.
The mini-map locations have been added.
The appearance of the mini-map has been changed to be more prominent.
The white center point of the play screen has a black border to reduce screen sickness.
Changed some text that was difficult to read.
The difficulty of some puzzles has been slightly increased.
Some puzzles have been modified to make them easier to understand.
Fixed a bug caused by enemy vomit.
Fixed a bug in which the enemy could find you even though you were through a wall in some places.
Fixed other minor bugs.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)
